privacy.section.accounts.heading: Authentication, user accounts & OAuth federation
privacy.section.accounts.li1.text: email addresses, secure password hashes (where applicable), and user profile configurations.
privacy.section.accounts.li2.text: when authenticating via external identity providers (such as GitHub, Google, Apple, GitLab, or a custom OIDC provider), ROUT securely ingests only the necessary baseline identifiers — email and display name — for active session maintenance.
privacy.section.accounts.li3.text: sovereign profile management (WebAuthn passkeys, custom OIDC via Keycloak or Authentik) is kept strictly separate from regulated fiat payment gateways (SEPA, PayPal, Venmo). Financial verification data is processed independently by PCI-DSS compliant providers and is never joined to your decentralised identity records.
privacy.section.accounts.li4.text: essential authentication state is maintained via isolated secure cookies and local storage tokens. Zero commercial tracking pixels or third-party analytics scripts exist on authenticated endpoints.
privacy.section.api.body: API interactions generate minimal technical access logs — timestamp, endpoint URI, response status, and rate-limiting counters — retained exclusively for infrastructure security, defence against DDoS attacks, and API stability enforcement.
privacy.section.api.heading: Programmatic access, API keys & rate limiting
privacy.section.controller.heading: Legal basis & controller identification
privacy.section.controller.p1.a: ROUT is operated as an independent developer infrastructure project by an individual creator, established in Brussels, Belgium (EU). The creator acts as the
privacy.section.controller.p1.b: for all processing described here. The architecture is zero-trust by design: local execution first, data minimisation throughout, and absolute transparency about what leaves your device.
privacy.section.controller.p2.a: Contact channel for all privacy matters:
privacy.section.controller.p2.b: . Statutory response timeline: we answer data subject requests
privacy.section.controller.p3.strong: Gegevensbeschermingsautoriteit (GBA) / Autorité de protection des données (APD)
privacy.section.domains.body: When end-users route traffic through custom domains linked to ROUT, core proxy and routing metadata are handled strictly for high-precision redirection and SSL termination. Visitor IP tracking on custom domain zones is disabled to preserve user sovereignty.
privacy.section.domains.heading: Custom domains & infrastructure routing
privacy.section.dynamic.heading: Dynamic routing, short links & anonymous analytics
privacy.section.dynamic.li1.text: we process destination URLs solely to execute the redirects you requested.
privacy.section.dynamic.li2.text: collection of coarse, strictly anonymised scan metadata — timestamp, country-level geolocation, and device category family.
privacy.section.dynamic.li3.text: full visitor IP addresses are never logged or stored. Visitor browser fingerprinting is explicitly disabled. Advertising profiling and cross-site tracking are fundamentally omitted.
privacy.section.dynamic.li4.a: while browser-based QR generation is 100% local and zero-knowledge, dynamic link and profile hub resolution
privacy.section.dynamic.li4.b: necessarily passes through network nodes. Standard transport metadata (IP address, User-Agent) is processed in-memory strictly for real-time routing and immediate DDoS mitigation, with
privacy.section.dynamic.li5.text: scan analytics are tied directly to the lifecycle of the dynamic link — purging or deleting a link instantly erases its aggregated statistics.
privacy.section.hosting.heading: Sovereign infrastructure & hosting (EU)
privacy.section.hosting.p1.a: All user state and relational configurations are stored within
privacy.section.hosting.p1.b: data centres on managed PostgreSQL infrastructure, under a strict Data Processing Agreement (DPA) featuring encryption in transit and at rest.
privacy.section.hosting.p2.text: primary databases, automated backups and routing proxies all operate inside the EEA. No production personal data is replicated to jurisdictions subject to extraterritorial surveillance frameworks such as the US CLOUD Act.
privacy.section.oauth.google.text: ROUT requests the youtube.readonly scope solely to display your public channel statistics and recent videos on your profile. We do not sell, share or rent Google user data to third parties, and we never use it for personalised advertising or to train AI/LLM models.
privacy.section.oauth.heading: External APIs, OAuth & linked accounts
privacy.section.oauth.intro: When you link an external service (such as Google/YouTube, Snapchat, Meta/Instagram, GitHub, Spotify or the Fediverse), ROUT receives only the data needed to show that service on your own profile.
privacy.section.oauth.meta.text: Data obtained through the Meta Graph API is strictly isolated and never combined with external advertising networks.
privacy.section.oauth.revoke: You can disconnect any service at any time in the Studio; its tokens are then deleted permanently. See the data deletion instructions at /data-deletion.
privacy.section.oauth.snap.text: ROUT retrieves only your Display Name and Bitmoji avatar for display on your profile. Friend lists and location data are never requested or stored.
privacy.section.oauth.tokens.text: Access and refresh tokens are stored AES-256 encrypted on the server. They are never shown in the browser, never logged and never shared.
privacy.section.payments.heading: Micro-payments, verification fees & financial data
privacy.section.payments.p1: Financial transactions for account verification or premium routing tiers are processed securely through certified, PCI-DSS compliant third-party payment gateways. ROUT does not store raw credit card credentials, IBAN mandates or other sensitive financial instruments on its own infrastructure.
privacy.section.payments.p2.text: the billing record required by accounting law lives in a distinct processing context from your handle, passkeys and published profile data. Regulated payment identity is never merged into, exported with, or used to enrich sovereign identity records.
privacy.section.rights.heading: Enforceable data subject rights (GDPR Chapter III)
privacy.section.static.body: Static QR codes are compiled and generated entirely client-side, inside your browser's local sandbox. Payload contents — URLs, vCards, Wi-Fi keys, IBAN strings — never touch ROUT servers, are never intercepted, and generate zero server-side logs or residual telemetry. Nothing is uploaded, so there is nothing for us to store, disclose, or lose.
privacy.section.static.heading: Static QR codes — absolute zero-data architecture

verify.badge.blue.body: Proves your legal identity via your bank or eID. Made for creators, companies and public figures who do not want to be impersonated. Unlocks the clean URL rout.be/name, donations and a relay address on @rout.be.
verify.badge.blue.title: The blue check
verify.badge.blue.where: Shown on your main profile: rout.be/name
verify.badge.early.body: An honour mark, not proof of identity: it shows you supported ROUT while it was still small. It does not replace the blue check and grants no extra rights to a handle.
verify.badge.early.title: The Early Believer fleur-de-lis
verify.badge.early.where: Shown next to your name on both profiles
verify.badge.shield.body: Confirms only that this alias profile is linked to a verified human. No name, no documents, no behavioural tracking. Ideal if you want to stay pseudonymous and still show you are not a bot.
verify.badge.shield.title: The privacy shield
verify.badge.shield.where: Shown on your free alias profile: rout.be/u/alias
verify.intro: Three marks, three promises. The blue check says who you are, the privacy shield says a human is behind the profile, and the fleur-de-lis shows who was there from day one. None of them gives us a profile we could sell.
verify.keep.body: The outcome of the check (passed or not), the verified name and the date. No document scans, no biometrics, no resale, no ad profile. You can have your verification revoked and your data erased at any time.
verify.keep.title: What we keep
verify.step1.body: You send a symbolic amount from your own bank account with a unique reference. Card, Bancontact, iDEAL or a classic transfer — all fine.
verify.step1.title: You transfer a small amount
verify.step2.body: The name on the transfer comes straight from your bank. We compare it with the name on your profile. We do not keep your account number as proof of identity.
verify.step2.title: Your bank confirms your name
verify.step3.body: On a match your main profile gets the blue check and the clean URL rout.be/name. Your free alias profile at rout.be/u/alias gets the privacy shield at the same time. No copy of your ID card in some folder.
verify.step3.title: Your check appears
verify.steps.title: Step by step
verify.title: How verification works at ROUT
